kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أتعالم (form VI)
# أَتَعَالَمُ (ʔataʕālamu) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.la.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَعَالَمَ (taʕālama)
# أَتَعَالَمَ (ʔataʕālama) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.la.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَالَمَ (taʕālama)
# أَتَعَالَمْ (ʔataʕālam) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.lam/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَعَالَمَ (taʕālama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
